bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches may enter after search; larger or opaque bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking includes the Railtech lot at New Road and Weston Streets without extra charge. Paid Premier and EZ Out parking can be bought on arrival, with event-dependent rates.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the EZ Out lot at the east end of the Reverend Moody Overpass and Savitt Way, by the Mini Cooper dealership. Arrange for your driver to return 45 minutes before the show ends.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold inside. Guests may bring food that fits in a clear one-gallon bag.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance and restrooms are accessible; routes to seating and lawn are uphill for about 200–300 feet. Accessible parking is first come, first served in Premier Parking with a valid tag.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Leaving the theater prevents re-entry without a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Box Office is to the left of the main entrance and is open on show days only, from 2 pm until the main act takes the stage. All tickets are digital, so the account holder needs their phone at the entrance. The Box Office can help with ticket issues but can't access tickets bought through third-party sites.

gates.summary: Guests may undergo detector screening, pat-downs and bag inspection at entry; consult the event page for door times.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
